temperature evolution derivative. Input and output temperatures are in KELVIN.\nAdded May 2012: when Tm = Tr, return -Tr (needed by CLASS)\nCorrected June 2016: in the presence of heating, Tm can cross Tr, so added a criterion\nfor returning -Tr when quasi-steady state. Note: this is not very \"clean\", there should\nbe some flag for quasi-steady-state, will eventually fix.\nAdded December 2014: possibility of additional energy deposition dEdtdV in eV/s/cm^3.\n******************************************************************************************/\n\ndouble rec_dTmdlna(double z, double xe, double Tm, REC_COSMOPARAMS *cosmo, double dEdtdV, double H) {\n  double fsR = cosmo->fsR;\n  double meR = cosmo->meR;\n  double Tr  = cosmo->T0 *(1.+z);\n  double nH  = cosmo->nH0 *cube(1.+z);\n  return ( (Tr/Tm-1.<1e-10  && Tr > 3000.)  ? -Tr :\n          -2.*Tm + fsR*fsR/meR/meR/meR*4.91466895548409e-22*Tr*Tr*Tr*Tr*xe/(1.+xe+cosmo->fHe)*(Tr-Tm)/H\n          + (1.+2.*xe)/3. *dEdtdV /kBoltz /(1.5 *nH*(1.+xe+cosmo->fHe))/H);\n   /* Coefficient = 8 sigma_T a_r / (3 m_e c) */\n   /* Here Tr, Tm are the actual (not rescaled) temperatures */\n}\n\ndouble Tm_implicit(double z, double xe, double Tm, REC_COSMOPARAMS *cosmo, double dEdtdV, double H, double DLNA) {\n  double fsR = cosmo->fsR;\n  double meR = cosmo->meR;\n  double Tr  = cosmo->T0 *(1.+z);\n  double nH  = cosmo->nH0 *cube(1.+z);\n  double gamma = fsR*fsR/meR/meR/meR*4.91466895548409e-22*Tr*Tr*Tr*Tr*xe/(1.+xe+cosmo->fHe)/H;\n  return (Tm + DLNA*(gamma*Tr + (1.+2.*xe)/3. *dEdtdV /kBoltz /(1.5 *nH*(1.+xe+cosmo->fHe))/H) )/ ( 1.+(2.+gamma)*DLNA );\n}\n\n\n/************************************************************************\nExplicit integrator.\nInputs: deriv: derivative at current time step\n        deriv_prev: derivatives at two previous timesteps\n        (deriv_prev[0] = previous time, deriv_prev[1] = 2 timesteps ago)\nOutput: change in x per dt\n*************************************************************************/\ndouble hyrec_integrator(double deriv, double deriv_prev[2], double z) {\n  double result;\n\n  if (MODEL == FULL) result = 1.25 * deriv - 0.25 *deriv_prev[1];\n  else result = 23./12.*deriv -16./12. * deriv_prev[0] + 5./12. *deriv_prev[1];\n\n  // update derivatives\n  deriv_prev[1] = deriv_prev[0];\n  deriv_prev[0] = deriv;\n\n  return result;\n}\n\n/**********************************************************************************************\nSecond-order explicit integrator for HeII abundance during HeII->HeI recombination.\nAssumes hydrogen ionization is in Saha equilibrium (free electrons being provided by both H and He).\nIf xHeII is close enough to Saha equilibrium do a post-Saha expansion.\ndxHeIIdlna_prev[0] = derivative at previous timestep\ndxHeIIdlna_prev[1] = derivative 2 timesteps prior\nz = input z\nH = Hubble parameter(z)\n***********************************************************************************************/\n\nvoid rec_get_xe_next1_He(HYREC_DATA *data, double z_in, double *xHeII, double dxHeIIdlna_prev[2],\n                         double *hubble_array, int flag) {\n\n  REC_COSMOPARAMS *cosmo = data->cosmo;\n  double Nz = data->Nz, dz = data->zmax/Nz;\n  int *error = &data->error;\n\n  double xH1, xH1_p, xH1_m, xHeIISaha, dxHeIISaha_dlna, DdxHeIIdlna_Dxe, dxHeIIdlna, z_out, Dxe, DLNA;\n  char sub_message[SIZE_ErrorM];\n  double H;\n  if (flag==10) DLNA = cosmo->dlna;\n  else DLNA = cosmo->dlna/10.;\n\n  if (hubble_array[0]==-1.) H  = rec_HubbleRate(cosmo, z_in);\n  else H = rec_interp1d(.0, dz, hubble_array, Nz, z_in, error, sub_message);\n\n  xH1        = rec_saha_xH1s(cosmo, z_in, *xHeII);\n  dxHeIIdlna = rec_helium_dxHeIIdlna(data, z_in, xH1, *xHeII, H);\n  /* Post-Saha approximation during the early phase of HeII->HeI recombination */\n  if (data->quasi_eq == 1) {\n    z_out     = (1.+z_in)*exp(-DLNA)-1.;\n    xHeIISaha = rec_saha_xHeII(cosmo, z_out);\n\n    dxHeIISaha_dlna  = (1.+z_out)*(rec_saha_xHeII(cosmo, z_out-0.5)\n                                  -rec_saha_xHeII(cosmo, z_out+0.5));\n\n    Dxe    = 0.01*(cosmo->fHe - xHeIISaha);\n    xH1_p = rec_saha_xH1s(cosmo, z_out, xHeIISaha+Dxe);\n    xH1_m = rec_saha_xH1s(cosmo, z_out, xHeIISaha-Dxe);\n\n    if (hubble_array[0]==-1.) H  = rec_HubbleRate(cosmo, z_out);\n    else H = rec_interp1d(.0, dz, hubble_array, Nz, z_out, error, sub_message);\n\n    DdxHeIIdlna_Dxe  = (rec_helium_dxHeIIdlna(data, z_out, xH1_p, xHeIISaha+Dxe, H)\n                       -rec_helium_dxHeIIdlna(data, z_out, xH1_m, xHeIISaha-Dxe, H))/2./Dxe;\n\n    *xHeII = xHeIISaha + dxHeIISaha_dlna/DdxHeIIdlna_Dxe;\n    /* Check that the post-Saha approximation is still valid. If not, switch it off for future iterations */\n    if (fabs(*xHeII - xHeIISaha) > DXHEII_MAX) data->quasi_eq = 0;\n  }\n\n  /* Otherwise integrate ODE */\n  else *xHeII += DLNA * hyrec_integrator(dxHeIIdlna, dxHeIIdlna_prev,z_in);\n\n  if (*error == 1) {\n    sprintf(sub_message, \"  called from rec_get_xe_next1_He at z = %f\\n\", z_in);\n    strcat(data->error_message, sub_message);\n  }\n}\n\n\n/***************************************************************************************************\nQuasi-equilibrium solution for the hydrogen neutral density at z\nUsed at early stages when the system is stiff. After that switch to explicit second-order solver.\ninput:  xH1 at previous time step\noutput: xH1 at z.\niz_rad is the index for the radiation field at z\n***************************************************************************************************/\n\nvoid rec_xH1_stiff(HYREC_DATA *data, int model, double z, double xHeII, double *xH1, unsigned iz_rad, double H){\n\n  REC_COSMOPARAMS *cosmo = data->cosmo;\n  int *error = &data->error;\n\n  double ainv, xH1sSaha, xHIISaha, dxH1sSaha_dlna, dxH1sdlna_Saha, DdxH1sdlna_DxH1s, T, nH, Dxe;\n  int model_stiff;\t// To use EMLA2p2s model for PostSaha in FULL and SWIFT mode\n  char sub_message[SIZE_ErrorM];\n\n  // Set model for rec_xH1_stiff. FULL mode uses EMLA2s2p for stiff.\n  // SWIFT mode uses EMLA2s2p for stiff when z is not in the range of redshifts for SWIFT fitting function.\n\n  T = kBoltz*cosmo->T0 * (ainv=1.+z);\n\n  if (model == FULL) {\n    model_stiff = EMLA2s2p;\n  }\n  else{\n    model_stiff = model;\n    if (model == SWIFT){\n      if (T/kBoltz/cosmo->fsR/cosmo->fsR/cosmo->meR > data->fit->swift_func[0][DKK_SIZE-1] ) model_stiff = EMLA2s2p;\n    }\n  }\n\n  nH = cosmo->nH0 *cube(1.+z);\n  xH1sSaha = rec_saha_xH1s(cosmo, z, xHeII);\n  xHIISaha = 1.-xH1sSaha;\n\n  dxH1sSaha_dlna = (1.+z)*(rec_saha_xH1s(cosmo, z-0.5, xHeII)\n                          -rec_saha_xH1s(cosmo, z+0.5, xHeII));\n                  /* (partial xHII)/(partial lna). Use xH1s = 1-xHII for better accuracy. */\n  if (xHeII != 0.) {\n    dxH1sSaha_dlna = (1.+z)*(rec_saha_xH1s(cosmo, z-0.5, xHeII)\n                            -rec_saha_xH1s(cosmo, z+0.5, xHeII));\n    Dxe = 0.01*(cosmo->fHe - xHeII);\n    dxH1sSaha_dlna += (rec_saha_xH1s(cosmo, z, xHeII+Dxe)\n                      -rec_saha_xH1s(cosmo, z, xHeII-Dxe))/2./Dxe\n                      *rec_helium_dxHeIIdlna(data, z, xH1sSaha, xHeII, H);\n                   /* (partial xHII)/(partial xHeII).dxHeII/dlna */\n  }\n\n  dxH1sdlna_Saha = -rec_dxHIIdlna(data, model_stiff, xHIISaha + xHeII, xHIISaha, nH, H, T, T, iz_rad, z);\n  Dxe            = 0.01*xH1sSaha;\n  DdxH1sdlna_DxH1s = (rec_dxHIIdlna(data, model_stiff, xHIISaha+Dxe + xHeII, xHIISaha+Dxe, nH, H, T, T, iz_rad, z)\n                       -rec_dxHIIdlna(data, model_stiff, xHIISaha-Dxe + xHeII, xHIISaha-Dxe, nH, H, T, T, iz_rad, z))/2./Dxe;\n  *xH1 = xH1sSaha + (dxH1sSaha_dlna - dxH1sdlna_Saha)/DdxH1sdlna_DxH1s;\n\n\n  if (fabs(*xH1 - xH1sSaha) > DXHII_MAX)  data->quasi_eq = 0;\n  //if (z<1700.) *stiff = 0;   /* Used when calculating the correction function for SWIFT mode. */\n\n  /* Update photon population when MODEL = FULL */\n  if (model == FULL) rec_dxHIIdlna(data, model, xHeII + 1.-*xH1, 1.-*xH1, nH, H, T, T, iz_rad, z);\n\n  if (*xH1 < 0. || *xH1 != *xH1) {\n    sprintf(sub_message, \"xH1 < 0 in rec_xH1_stiff: at z = %f, xH1 = %E\\n\", z, *xH1);\n    strcat(data->error_message, sub_message);\n    *error = 1;\n  }\n\n  if (*error == 1) {\n    sprintf(sub_message, \"  called from rec_xH1_stiff at z = %f\\n\", z);\n    strcat(data->error_message, sub_message);\n    return;\n  }\n  return;\n}\n\n\n\n/*****************************************************************************************************\nSecond-order integrator (unless stiff system) used to evolve simultaneously HI and HeII.\nWhen hydrogen is close to Saha equilibrium but there is still a significant amount of HeII,\nuse a post-Saha expansion for hydrogen. The other way around is not treated (simply integrate H and He until\nthere is almost no HeII left, then integrate H only)\n******************************************************************************************************/\n\nvoid get_rec_next2_HHe(HYREC_DATA *data, int model, double z_in, long iz, double *xH1, double *xHeII,\n                       double dxHIIdlna_prev[2], double dxHeIIdlna_prev[2], double H) {\n\n  REC_COSMOPARAMS *cosmo = data->cosmo;\n  int *error = &data->error;\n  double Tm = data->Tm_output[iz-1];\n  long iz_rad = iz-1-data->rad->iz_rad_0;\n\n  double dxHeIIdlna, dxHIIdlna=0., z_out, xe;\n  double nH, TR, DLNA;\n  char sub_message[SIZE_ErrorM];\n  DLNA = cosmo->dlna;\n  xe = *xHeII + 1.- (*xH1);\n  nH = cosmo->nH0 *cube(1.+z_in);\n  TR = kBoltz * cosmo->T0 *(1.+z_in);\n  /* Evolve HeII by solving ODE */\n  dxHeIIdlna  = rec_helium_dxHeIIdlna(data, z_in, *xH1, *xHeII, H);\n  *xHeII     += DLNA * hyrec_integrator(dxHeIIdlna, dxHeIIdlna_prev, z_in);\n\n  /* Compute dxHII/dlna. This also correctly updates the radiation field at z_in,\n     which is required even when using the stiff approximation */\n\n  /* If system is stiff use the quasi-equilibrium solution */\n  if(data->quasi_eq == 1){\n    z_out = (1.+z_in)*exp(-DLNA)-1.;\n    rec_xH1_stiff(data, model, z_out, *xHeII, xH1, iz_rad+1, H);\n    hyrec_integrator(dxHIIdlna, dxHIIdlna_prev, z_in);\n  }\n\n    /* Otherwise use second-order explicit solver */\n  else {\n    dxHIIdlna = rec_dxHIIdlna(data, model, xe, 1.-(*xH1), nH, H, kBoltz*Tm, TR, iz_rad, z_in);\n    *xH1 -= DLNA * hyrec_integrator(dxHIIdlna, dxHIIdlna_prev, z_in);\n  }\n\n    /* Checking for errors */\n  if (*xH1 < 0. || *xH1 > 1. || *xH1 != *xH1) {\n    sprintf(sub_message, \"xH1 < 0 or xH1 > 1 in get_rec_next2_HHe: at z = %f, xH1 = %E\\n\", z_out, *xH1);\n    strcat(data->error_message, sub_message);\n    *error = 1;\n  }\n  if (*error == 1) {\n    sprintf(sub_message, \"  called from get_rec_next2_HHe at z = %f\\n\", z_out);\n    strcat(data->error_message, sub_message);\n    return;\n  }\n}\n\n/*********************************************************************************************************\nSecond-order integrator (unless stiff system) to evolve hydrogen only, assuming helium has entirely recombined.\nTm is given as an input (to avoid computing it twice) and fixed to quasi-equilibrium value with Tr.\nInput : xe [at z_in]\nOutput: xe [at next timestep]\n**********************************************************************************************************/\n\nvoid rec_get_xe_next1_H(HYREC_DATA *data, int model, double z_in, long iz, double xe_in, double Tm_in,\n                        double *xe_out, double *Tm_out, double dxedlna_prev[2], double H, int flag) {\n\n  REC_COSMOPARAMS *cosmo = data->cosmo;\n  int *error = &data->error;\n  long iz_rad = iz-1-data->rad->iz_rad_0;\n\n  double dxedlna, z_out;\n  double nH, TR, xH1, dEdtdV, DLNA;\n  char sub_message[SIZE_ErrorM];\n  if (flag==10) DLNA = cosmo->dlna;\n  else DLNA = cosmo->dlna/10.;\n\n  z_out   = (1.+z_in)*exp(-DLNA)-1.;\n  nH = cosmo->nH0 *cube(1.+z_in);\n  TR = kBoltz *cosmo->T0 *(1.+z_in);\n\n  dEdtdV = cosmo->inj_params->ion*3*nH*EI / (1-xe_in);\n  /* Compute dxHII/dlna. This also correctly updates the radiation field at z_in,\n     which is required even when using the stiff approximation */\n\n  /* If system is stiff use the quasi-equilibrium solution */\n  if (data->quasi_eq == 1) {\n    xH1 = 1.-xe_in;\n    rec_xH1_stiff(data, model, z_out, 0, &xH1, iz_rad+1, H);\n    *xe_out = 1.-xH1;\n    dxedlna_prev[1] = dxedlna_prev[0];\n    dxedlna_prev[0] = (*xe_out-xe_in)/DLNA;\n  }\n    /* Otherwise use second-order explicit solver */\n  else {\n    dxedlna = rec_dxHIIdlna(data, model, xe_in, xe_in, nH, H, kBoltz*Tm_in, TR, iz_rad, z_in);\n    *xe_out = xe_in + DLNA * hyrec_integrator(dxedlna, dxedlna_prev, z_in);\n  }\n\n  /* Quasi-steady state solution for Tm */\n  *Tm_out = rec_Tmss(z_out, *xe_out, cosmo, dEdtdV, H);\n\n  // Test that the outcome is sensible\n  if (*xe_out > 1. || *xe_out < 0. || *xe_out != *xe_out) {\n    sprintf(sub_message, \"xe > 1 or xe < 0 in get_rec_next1_H at z = %E, xe = %E\\n\", z_out, *xe_out);\n    strcat(data->error_message, sub_message);\n    *error = 1;\n  }\n  if (*error == 1) {\n    sprintf(sub_message, \"  called from get_rec_next1_H at z = %f\\n\", z_out);\n    strcat(data->error_message, sub_message);\n    return;\n  }\n}\n\n\n/**********************************************************************************************\nSecond-order integrator for evolving xe and Tm simultaneously\nUsed for Hydrogen recombination only\nMay 2012: added a switch so Peebles model can be used at low redshift.\nSeptember 2016: added dEdtdV_dep, the *deposited* energy\n(as opposed to dE_dtdV which is the instantaenously injected energy)\nJuly 2020: added implicit integration method\n***********************************************************************************************/\n\nvoid rec_get_xe_next2_HTm(HYREC_DATA *data, int model, double z_in, long iz, double dxedlna_prev[2],\n                          double dTmdlna_prev[2], double H, double z_out, double H_next) {\n\n  REC_COSMOPARAMS *cosmo = data->cosmo;\n  double xe_in = data->xe_output[iz-1];\n  double Tm_in = data->Tm_output[iz-1];\n  int *error = &data->error;\n  long iz_rad = iz-1-data->rad->iz_rad_0;\n\n  double dxedlna, dTmdlna, nH, TR, dEdtdV, DLNA;\n  char sub_message[SIZE_ErrorM];\n  DLNA = cosmo->dlna;\n\n  nH = cosmo->nH0 *cube(1.+z_in);\n  TR = kBoltz *cosmo->T0 *(1.+z_in);\n  dEdtdV = cosmo->inj_params->ion*3*nH*EI / (1-xe_in);\n  /*For low redshifts (z < 20 or so) use Peeble's model.\n    The precise model does not metter much here as\n    1) the free electron fraction is basically zero (~1e-4) in any case and\n    2) the universe is going to be reionized around that epoch */\n\n  if (TR/cosmo->fsR/cosmo->fsR/cosmo->meR <= TR_MIN\n     || kBoltz*Tm_in/TR <= T_RATIO_MIN) model = PEEBLES;\n    dxedlna = rec_dxHIIdlna(data, model, xe_in, xe_in, nH, H, kBoltz*Tm_in, TR, iz_rad, z_in);\n\n  dTmdlna = rec_dTmdlna(z_in, xe_in, Tm_in, cosmo, dEdtdV, H);\n\n  data->Tm_evolve_implicit = 1;\n  if (fabs(1-dTmdlna_prev[0]/dTmdlna)<DTM_DIFF_MAX) data->Tm_evolve_implicit = 0;\n  if (data->Tm_evolve_implicit == 1){\n    dTmdlna_prev[0] = dTmdlna;\n    dTmdlna_prev[1] = dTmdlna_prev[0];\n    data->xe_output[iz] = xe_in + DLNA *hyrec_integrator(dxedlna, dxedlna_prev, z_in);\n    data->Tm_output[iz] = Tm_implicit(z_out, data->xe_output[iz], Tm_in, cosmo, dEdtdV, H_next, DLNA);\n  }\n  else {\n    data->xe_output[iz] = xe_in + DLNA *hyrec_integrator(dxedlna, dxedlna_prev, z_in);\n    data->Tm_output[iz] = Tm_in + DLNA *hyrec_integrator(dTmdlna, dTmdlna_prev, z_in);\n  }\n\n  if (*error == 1) {\n    sprintf(sub_message, \"  called from rec_get_xe_next2_HTm at z = %f\\n\", z_in);\n    strcat(data->error_message, sub_message);\n    return;\n  }\n}\n\n\n/****************************************************************************************************\nBuilds a recombination history with a given model\n(model = PEEBLES, RECFAST, EMLA2s2p, FULL, or SWIFT)\nAdded May 2012: The radiation field was added as an input so it can be extracted if desired\nReplaced condition iz < param->nz by equivalent z >= 0 (so param.nz not needed anymore)\nAdded September 2016: follow the deposited energy dEdtdV_dep\nAdded July 2020: Implicit integration for Tm\n\t\t\t\t Adopting a smaller time step when diff.eq is stiff in SWIFT mode\n****************************************************************************************************/\n\nchar* rec_build_history(HYREC_DATA *data, int model, double *hubble_array){\n\n  REC_COSMOPARAMS *cosmo = data->cosmo;\n  int *error = &data->error;\n\n  double *xe_output = data->xe_output, *Tm_output = data->Tm_output;\n  int Nz = data->Nz;\n  double zstart = data->zmax, zend = data->zmin;\n  long iz;\n  double dxHIIdlna_prev[2], dTmdlna_prev[2], dxHeIIdlna_prev[2];\n  double dxHIIdlna_prev_sub[2], dxHeIIdlna_prev_sub[2], xHeII_prev[4];\n  double z, dz, DLNA, Delta_xe, xHeII, xH1, dEdtdV_dep, nH, H;\n  double *ion = &cosmo->inj_params->ion;\n  double *exclya = &cosmo->inj_params->exclya;\n  double z_out=0., H_next;\n  int flag=10;\n  double xe_i, Tm_i;\n\n  DLNA = cosmo->dlna;\n  dz = zstart/Nz;\n  // Index at which we start integrating Hydrogen recombination, and corresponding redshift\n  data->rad->iz_rad_0  = (long) floor(1 + log(kBoltz*cosmo->T0/square(cosmo->fsR)/cosmo->meR*(1.+zstart)/TR_MAX)/DLNA);\n  data->rad->z0   = (1.+zstart)*exp(-data->rad->iz_rad_0 * DLNA) - 1.;\n\n  z = zstart;\n  /********* He III -> II Saha phase. Tm = Tr. Stop when xHeIII = 1e-8 *********/\n  Delta_xe = cosmo->fHe;   /* Delta_xe = xHeIII here */\n  for(iz = 0; z >= 0. && Delta_xe > 1e-8; iz++) {\n    z = (1.+zstart)*exp(-cosmo->dlna*iz) - 1.;\n    xe_output[iz] = rec_xesaha_HeII_III(cosmo, z, &Delta_xe);\n    Tm_output[iz] = cosmo->T0 * (1.+z);\n  }\n\n  /******** He II -> I recombination.\n    Hydrogen in Saha equilibrium.\n    Tm fixed to steady state.\n    Neglect any energy injection.\n    Integrate until TR is low enough that can start integrating hydrogen recombination\n    (this occurs at index izH0 computed in rec_get_cosmoparam).\n    Start with quasi-equilibrium approximation.\n  ********/\n\n  dxHeIIdlna_prev[1] = dxHeIIdlna_prev[0] = 0.;\n\n  xHeII    = rec_saha_xHeII(cosmo, z);\n  data->quasi_eq = 1;                    /* Start with post-saha expansion */\n\n  dxHeIIdlna_prev_sub[1] = dxHeIIdlna_prev[1];\n  dxHeIIdlna_prev_sub[0] = dxHeIIdlna_prev[0];\n  xHeII_prev[3] = xHeII;\n  xHeII_prev[2] = xHeII;\n  xHeII_prev[1] = xHeII;\n  xHeII_prev[0] = xHeII;\n\n  data->loop_after_quasi=1;\n  for(; iz <= data->rad->iz_rad_0; iz++) {\n\n    if (model == SWIFT && data->quasi_eq == 0 && data->loop_after_quasi == 1){\n      xe_i = xe_output[iz-1]; Tm_i = Tm_output[iz-1];\n      for (flag=0;flag<10;flag++) {\n        rec_get_xe_next1_He(data, z, &xHeII, dxHeIIdlna_prev_sub, hubble_array, flag);\n        z  = (1.+zstart)*exp(-DLNA*(iz-1+(flag+1)/10.)) - 1.;\n        xH1 = rec_saha_xH1s(cosmo, z, xHeII);\n        xe_i = 1.-xH1 + xHeII;\n\n        if (hubble_array[0]==-1.) H  = rec_HubbleRate(cosmo, z);\n        else H = rec_interp1d(.0, dz, hubble_array, Nz, z, error, data->error_message);\n        Tm_i = rec_Tmss(z, xe_i, cosmo, 0., H);\n      }\n      xe_output[iz] = xe_i; Tm_output[iz] = Tm_i;\n\n      xHeII_prev[3] = xHeII_prev[2];\n      xHeII_prev[2] = xHeII_prev[1];\n      xHeII_prev[1] = xHeII_prev[0];\n      xHeII_prev[0] = xHeII;\n      dxHeIIdlna_prev[1] = (xHeII_prev[1] - xHeII_prev[3])/2./DLNA;\n      dxHeIIdlna_prev[0] = (xHeII_prev[0] - xHeII_prev[2])/2./DLNA;\n\n      if (fabs(1-dxHeIIdlna_prev[1]/dxHeIIdlna_prev[0])<DXHEII_DIFF_MAX) data->loop_after_quasi = 0;\n    }\n    else{\n      rec_get_xe_next1_He(data, z, &xHeII, dxHeIIdlna_prev, hubble_array, flag);\n      z             = (1.+zstart)*exp(-DLNA*iz) - 1.;\n      xH1           = rec_saha_xH1s(cosmo, z, xHeII);\n      xe_output[iz] = 1.-xH1 + xHeII;\n\n      if (hubble_array[0]==-1.) H  = rec_HubbleRate(cosmo, z);\n      else H = rec_interp1d(.0, dz, hubble_array, Nz, z, error, data->error_message);\n\n      Tm_output[iz] = rec_Tmss(z, xe_output[iz], cosmo, 0., H);\n    }\n\n    if (*error == 1) return data->error_message;\n  }\n\n  /******** H II -> I and He II -> I simultaneous recombination (rarely needed but just in case)\n        Tm fixed to steady state.\n        Integrate H and He simultaneously until xHeII < XHEII_MIN\n        Start with post-saha expansion for hydrogen\n        Now account for possible energy injection.\n        Solve for dEdtdV_dep simultaneously;\n  ********/\n\n  dxHIIdlna_prev[1] = (xe_output[iz-2] - xe_output[iz-4])/2./DLNA - dxHeIIdlna_prev[1];\n  dxHIIdlna_prev[0] = (xe_output[iz-1] - xe_output[iz-3])/2./DLNA - dxHeIIdlna_prev[0];\n  data->quasi_eq          = 1;\n\n  // Initialize energy *deposition*\n  dEdtdV_dep = 0.;\n  nH = cosmo->nH0*cube(1.+z);\n\n  if (hubble_array[0]==-1.) H  = rec_HubbleRate(cosmo, z);\n  else H = rec_interp1d(.0, dz, hubble_array, Nz, z, error, data->error_message);\n\n  update_dEdtdV_dep(z, DLNA, xe_output[iz-1], Tm_output[iz-1], nH, H, cosmo->inj_params, &dEdtdV_dep);\n  *ion = dEdtdV_dep/3. /nH *xH1 /EI;\n  *exclya = *ion /0.75;\n\n  for(; z >= 0. && xHeII > XHEII_MIN; iz++) {\n\n    get_rec_next2_HHe(data, model, z, iz, &xH1, &xHeII, dxHIIdlna_prev, dxHeIIdlna_prev, H);\n    xe_output[iz] = 1.-xH1 + xHeII;\n\n    z  = (1.+zstart)*exp(-DLNA*iz) - 1.;\n\n    if (hubble_array[0]==-1.) H  = rec_HubbleRate(cosmo, z);\n    else H = rec_interp1d(.0, dz, hubble_array, Nz, z, error, data->error_message);\n\n    nH = cosmo->nH0*cube(1.+z);\n    Tm_output[iz] = rec_Tmss(z, xe_output[iz], cosmo, dEdtdV_dep, H);\n    update_dEdtdV_dep(z, DLNA, xe_output[iz], Tm_output[iz], nH, H, cosmo->inj_params, &dEdtdV_dep);\n    *ion = dEdtdV_dep/3. /nH *xH1 /EI;\n    *exclya = *ion /0.75;\n\n    if (*error == 1) return data->error_message;\n  }\n\n  /******** H recombination. Helium assumed entirely neutral.\n        Tm fixed to steady-state until its relative difference from Tr is DLNT_MAX\n  ********/\n  dxHIIdlna_prev_sub[1] = dxHIIdlna_prev[1];\n  dxHIIdlna_prev_sub[0] = dxHIIdlna_prev[0];\n  data->loop_after_quasi = 1;\n  for (; z >= 0. && fabs(1.-Tm_output[iz-1]/cosmo->T0/(1.+z)) < DLNT_MAX; iz++) {\n\n    if (model == SWIFT && data->loop_after_quasi == 1){\n      xe_i = xe_output[iz-1]; Tm_i = Tm_output[iz-1];\n      for (flag=0;flag<10;flag++) {\n        rec_get_xe_next1_H(data, model, z, iz, xe_i, Tm_i, &xe_i, &Tm_i, dxHIIdlna_prev_sub, H, flag);\n        z  = (1.+zstart)*exp(-DLNA*(iz-1+(flag+1)/10.)) - 1.;\n        nH = cosmo->nH0*cube(1.+z);\n\n        if (hubble_array[0]==-1.) H  = rec_HubbleRate(cosmo, z);\n        else H = rec_interp1d(.0, dz, hubble_array, Nz, z, error, data->error_message);\n\n        update_dEdtdV_dep(z, DLNA/10., xe_i, Tm_i, nH, H, cosmo->inj_params, &dEdtdV_dep);\n        *ion = dEdtdV_dep/3. /nH *(1.-xe_i) /EI;\n        *exclya = *ion /0.75;\n      }\n      xe_output[iz] = xe_i; Tm_output[iz] = Tm_i;\n      dxHIIdlna_prev[1] = (xe_output[iz-1] - xe_output[iz-3])/2./DLNA;\n      dxHIIdlna_prev[0] = (xe_output[iz] - xe_output[iz-2])/2./DLNA;\n\n      if (fabs(1-dxHIIdlna_prev[1]/dxHIIdlna_prev[0])<DXHII_DIFF_MAX) data->loop_after_quasi=0;\n    }\n\n    else{\n      rec_get_xe_next1_H(data, model, z, iz, xe_output[iz-1], Tm_output[iz-1], xe_output+iz, Tm_output+iz,\n                         dxHIIdlna_prev, H, flag);\n      if (data->quasi_eq == 1){\n          dxHIIdlna_prev[1] = (xe_output[iz-2] - xe_output[iz-4])/2./DLNA;\n          dxHIIdlna_prev[0] = (xe_output[iz-1] - xe_output[iz-3])/2./DLNA;\n      }\n      z  = (1.+zstart)*exp(-DLNA*iz) - 1.;\n      z_out  = (1.+zstart)*exp(-DLNA*(iz+1)) - 1.;\n      nH = cosmo->nH0*cube(1.+z);\n\n      if (hubble_array[0]==-1.) H  = rec_HubbleRate(cosmo, z);\n      else H = rec_interp1d(.0, dz, hubble_array, Nz, z, error, data->error_message);\n\n      update_dEdtdV_dep(z, DLNA, xe_output[iz], Tm_output[iz], nH, H, cosmo->inj_params, &dEdtdV_dep);\n      *ion = dEdtdV_dep/3. /nH *(1.-xe_output[iz]) /EI;\n      *exclya = *ion /0.75;\n    }\n    if (*error == 1) return data->error_message;\n  }\n\n  /******** Evolve xe and Tm simultaneously until z = zend\n      Note that the radiative transfer calculation is switched off automatically in the functions\n      rec_get_xe_next1_H and rec_get_xe_next2_HTm when it is no longer relevant.\n  ********/\n\n  dTmdlna_prev[1] = (Tm_output[iz-2] - Tm_output[iz-4])/2./DLNA;\n  dTmdlna_prev[0] = (Tm_output[iz-1] - Tm_output[iz-3])/2./DLNA;\n\n  if (hubble_array[0]==-1.) {\n    H  = rec_HubbleRate(cosmo, z);\n    H_next  = rec_HubbleRate(cosmo, z_out);\n  }\n  else {\n    H = rec_interp1d(.0, dz, hubble_array, Nz, z, error, data->error_message);\n    H_next = rec_interp1d(.0, dz, hubble_array, Nz, z_out, error, data->error_message);\n  }\n\n  for(; z > zend; iz++) {\n    rec_get_xe_next2_HTm(data, model, z, iz, dxHIIdlna_prev, dTmdlna_prev, H, z_out, H_next);\n    z  = (1.+zstart)*exp(-DLNA*iz) - 1.;\n    z_out  = (1.+zstart)*exp(-DLNA*(iz+1)) - 1.;\n    if (z < zend) z=0.;\n\n    if (hubble_array[0]==-1.) {\n      H  = rec_HubbleRate(cosmo, z);\n      H_next  = rec_HubbleRate(cosmo, z_out);\n    }\n    else {\n      H = rec_interp1d(.0, dz, hubble_array, Nz, z, error, data->error_message);\n      if (z_out > zend) H_next = rec_interp1d(.0, dz, hubble_array, Nz, z_out, error, data->error_message);\n      else H_next = H;\n    }\n    nH = cosmo->nH0*cube(1.+z);\n    update_dEdtdV_dep(z, DLNA, xe_output[iz], Tm_output[iz], nH, H, cosmo->inj_params, &dEdtdV_dep);\n    *ion = dEdtdV_dep/3. /nH *(1.-xe_output[iz]) /EI;\n    *exclya = *ion /0.75;\n\n    if (*error == 1) return data->error_message;\n  }\n  return data->error_message;\n}\n\n\n/***********************************************************\nFunction to allocate and initialize HYREC-2 internal tables\nNote that path_to_hyrec in HYREC_DATA should be defined first\nbefore calling hyrec_allocate().\n***********************************************************/\n\nvoid hyrec_allocate(HYREC_DATA *data, double zmax, double zmin) {\n  double DLNA;\n  if (MODEL == SWIFT) DLNA = DLNA_SWIFT;\n  else DLNA = DLNA_HYREC;\n\n  data->error = 0;\n  data->error_message=malloc(SIZE_ErrorM);\n  sprintf(data->error_message, \"\\n**** ERROR HAS OCCURRED in HYREC-2 ****\\n\");\n\n  data->zmax = (zmax > 3000.? zmax : 3000.);\n  data->zmin = zmin;\n\n  data->atomic = (HYREC_ATOMIC *) malloc(sizeof(HYREC_ATOMIC));\n  allocate_and_read_atomic(data->atomic, &data->error, data->path_to_hyrec, data->error_message);\n\n  data->fit = (FIT_FUNC *) malloc(sizeof(FIT_FUNC));\n  allocate_and_read_fit(data->fit, &data->error, data->path_to_hyrec, data->error_message);\n\n  data->cosmo  = (REC_COSMOPARAMS *) malloc(sizeof(REC_COSMOPARAMS));\n  data->cosmo->inj_params = (INJ_PARAMS *)  malloc(sizeof(INJ_PARAMS));\n\n  data->Nz = (long int) (log((1.+zmax)/(1.+zmin))/DLNA) + 2;\n  data->rad = (RADIATION *) malloc(sizeof(RADIATION));\n\n  // For now assume that radiation field never needed over more than 1 decade in redshift\n  // (typically from z ~ 1700 to 800 for recombination history)\n  // Will have to adapt for outputting radiation fields at lower z\n  if (MODEL == FULL)  allocate_radiation(data->rad, (long int) (log(10.)/DLNA), &data->error, data->error_message);\n\n  data->xe_output = create_1D_array(data->Nz, &data->error, data->error_message);\n  data->Tm_output = create_1D_array(data->Nz, &data->error, data->error_message);\n}\n\n\nvoid hyrec_free(HYREC_DATA *data) {\n  free_atomic(data->atomic);\n  free(data->cosmo->inj_params);\n  free(data->cosmo);\n  free(data->atomic);\n  free(data->xe_output);\n  free(data->Tm_output);\n  free(data->error_message);\n  if (MODEL == FULL) free_radiation(data->rad);\n  free(data->rad);\n  free_fit(data->fit);\n  free(data->fit);\n}\n\n/******************************************************************\nCompute a recombination history given input cosmological parameters\n********************************************************************/\n\nvoid hyrec_compute(HYREC_DATA *data, int model){\n  /* if Hubble_flag[0]=-1., HYREC-2 uses its own Hubble rate.\n  When HYREC-2 is included in CLASS, the Hubble rate should be given from CLASS.\n  In that case, rec_build_history() would be used directly not this function, hyrec_compute(). */\n  double Hubble_flag[1];\n  Hubble_flag[0] = -1.;\n\n  rec_build_history(data, model, Hubble_flag);\n}\n\n/*****\n     Once HYREC_DATA outputs are computed, obtain xe(z) and Tm(z) by interpolation\n*****/\n\ndouble hyrec_xe(double z, HYREC_DATA *data) {\n  if (z > data->zmax) return data->xe_output[0];\n  if (z < data->zmin) {\n    fprintf(stderr, \"\\033[1m\\033[31m error\\033[22;30m in hyrec_xe: requesting x_e at z = %f \", z);\n    fprintf(stderr, \"lower than zmin\\n\");\n    exit(1);\n  }\n  double DLNA = data->cosmo->dlna;\n  return rec_interp1d(-log(1.+data->zmax), DLNA, data->xe_output, data->Nz, -log(1.+z), &data->error, data->error_message);\n}\n\ndouble hyrec_Tm(double z, HYREC_DATA *data) {\n  if(z > data->zmax) return data->cosmo->T0*(1.+z);\n  if (z < data->zmin) {\n    fprintf(stderr, \"\\033[1m\\033[31m error\\033[22;30m in hyrec_Tm: requesting x_e at z = %f \", z);\n    fprintf(stderr, \"lower than zmin\\n\");\n    exit(1);\n  }\n  double DLNA = data->cosmo->dlna;\n  return rec_interp1d(-log(1.+data->zmax), DLNA, data->Tm_output, data->Nz, -log(1.+z), &data->error, data->error_message);\n}\n"
    },
    "upstream_wrap_hyrec.c": {
      "sha256": "e4785eb62b51835839e20da53944a5a170a715966b46b6f4745d9bef047c0ecb",
      "size_bytes": 7640,
      "utf8": "/**\n * Small wrapper file for the hyrec code to be used in thermodynamics\n * Nils Schoeneberg Feb 2019\n * */\n\n#include \"common.h\"\n#include \"thermodynamics.h\"\n#include \"wrap_hyrec.h\"\n\n\n/**\n * Initialize the thermohyrec structure, and in particular HyRec 2020.\n *\n * @param ppr   Input: pointer to precision structure\n * @param pba   Input: pointer to background structure\n * @param pth   Input: pointer to thermodynamics structure\n * @param phy Input/Output: pointer to thermohyrec structure\n * @return the error status\n */\nint thermodynamics_hyrec_init(struct precision* ppr, struct background * pba, struct thermodynamics * pth, double Nnow, double T_cmb, double fHe, double zstart_hyrec, struct thermohyrec* phy){\n\n  /** Summary: */\n\n  if(phy->thermohyrec_verbose > 0){\n    printf(\" -> Using the hyrec wrapper programmed by Nils Sch. (Oct2020)\\n\");\n    printf(\"    implements HyRec2 version Oct 2020 by Yacine Ali-Haimoud, Chris Hirata, and Nanoom Lee\\n\");\n  }\n\n  /** - allocate necessary data structures */\n  class_alloc(phy->data,\n              sizeof(HYREC_DATA),\n              phy->error_message);\n\n  phy->zend = 0.;\n  phy->zstart = zstart_hyrec;\n\n  if(phy->thermohyrec_verbose > 1){\n    printf(\"    Starting HyRec at z = %.10e until z = %.10e\\n\",phy->zstart, phy->zend);\n  }\n\n  /** - pass the path to the hyrec files */\n  class_sprintf(phy->path_to_hyrec,\"%s%s\",ppr->base_path,ppr->hyrec_path);\n  phy->data->path_to_hyrec = phy->path_to_hyrec; // Just a pointer assignment\n  /** - allocate hyrec internally */\n  hyrec_allocate(phy->data, phy->zstart, phy->zend);\n  /* Error during allocation */\n  if(phy->data->error != 0){\n    class_call_message(phy->error_message,\"hyrec_allocate\",phy->data->error_message);\n    return _FAILURE_;\n  }\n\n  /** - set cosmological parameters for hyrec */\n  phy->data->cosmo->T0 = T_cmb;\n  phy->data->cosmo->obh2 = pba->Omega0_b*pba->h*pba->h;\n  phy->data->cosmo->ocbh2 = pba->Omega0_nfsm*pba->h*pba->h;\n\n  phy->data->cosmo->YHe = pth->YHe;\n  phy->data->cosmo->Neff = pba->Neff;\n  phy->data->cosmo->fHe = fHe; /* abundance of helium relative to hydrogen by number */\n  phy->data->cosmo->fsR = 1.;\n  phy->data->cosmo->meR = 1.;\n  phy->data->cosmo->nH0 = Nnow*1e-6;\n\n  /** - set other parameters for hyrec */\n  /* XEII_MIN = 1e-6 defined in history.h\n     HYREC-2 calculates Helium recombinations only until xHeII ~ XEII_MIN */\n  phy->xHeII_limit = XHEII_MIN;\n\n  return _SUCCESS_;\n}\n\n\n/**\n * Free all memory space allocated by thermodynamics_hyrec_init\n *\n * @param pth Input/Output: pointer to thermohyrec structure (to be freed)\n * @return the error status\n */\nint thermodynamics_hyrec_free(struct thermohyrec* phy){\n\n  /* We just need to free hyrec (without error management) */\n  hyrec_free(phy->data);\n  free(phy->data);\n\n  return _SUCCESS_;\n}\n\n/**\n * Calculate the derivative of the hydrogen HII ionization fraction\n *\n * @param pth   Input: pointer to thermodynamics structure\n * @param phy   Input: pointer to thermohyrec structure\n * @param x_H   Input: hydrogen HII ionization fraction\n * @param x_He  Input: helium HeIII ionization fraction\n * @param nH    Input: comoving total number of hydrogen atoms\n * @param z     Input: current cosmological redshift\n * @param Hz    Input: current value of hubble parameter in 1/s\n * @param Tmat  Input: temperature of baryons in Kelvin\n * @param Trad  Input: temperature of photons in Kelvin\n * @param alpha Input: fine structure constant relative to today\n * @param me    Input: effective electron mass relative to today\n * @param dx_H_dz        Output: change in ionization fraction of hydrogen HII\n * @return the error status\n */\nint hyrec_dx_H_dz(struct thermodynamics* pth, struct thermohyrec* phy, double x_H, double x_He, double xe, double nH, double z, double Hz, double Tmat, double Trad, double alpha, double me, double *dx_H_dz) {\n\n  /** Summary: */\n\n  /** - define local variables */\n  struct injection* pin = &(pth->in);\n  long iz = 0;\n  int model;\n  double Trad_phys;\n\n  /** - do tests */\n  class_test(MODEL == FULL, phy->error_message, \"FULL mode is currently not allowed for HyRec-2\");\n\n  /** - assign variables */\n  if (pth->has_exotic_injection == _TRUE_) {\n    phy->data->cosmo->inj_params->ion = pin->pvecdeposition[pin->index_dep_ionH]/nH/(_E_H_ion_*_eV_);\n    phy->data->cosmo->inj_params->exclya = pin->pvecdeposition[pin->index_dep_lya]/nH/(_E_H_lya_*_eV_);\n  }\n  else{\n    phy->data->cosmo->inj_params->ion = 0.;\n    phy->data->cosmo->inj_params->exclya = 0.;\n  }\n  if (pth->has_varconst == _TRUE_) {\n    phy->data->cosmo->fsR = alpha;\n    phy->data->cosmo->meR = me;\n  }\n\n  Trad_phys = Trad*kBoltz;\n  if (pth->has_varconst == _TRUE_) {\n    Trad_phys /= phy->data->cosmo->fsR*phy->data->cosmo->fsR*phy->data->cosmo->meR; //According to 1705.03925\n  }\n\n  if (Trad_phys <= TR_MIN || Tmat/Trad <= T_RATIO_MIN) { model = PEEBLES; }\n  else { model = MODEL; }\n\n  /** - convert to correct units, and retrieve derivative */\n  *dx_H_dz = -1./(1.+z)* rec_dxHIIdlna(phy->data, model, xe, x_H, nH*1e-6, Hz, Tmat*kBoltz, Trad*kBoltz, iz, z);\n\n  /** - do error management */\n  if(phy->data->error != 0){\n    class_call_message(phy->error_message,\"rec_dxHIIdlna\",phy->data->error_message);\n    return _FAILURE_;\n  }\n\n  return _SUCCESS_;\n}\n\n/**\n * Calculate the derivative of the helium HeIII ionization fraction\n *\n * @param pth   Input: pointer to thermodynamics structure\n * @param phy   Input: pointer to thermohyrec structure\n * @param x_H   Input: hydrogen HII ionization fraction\n * @param x_He  Input: helium HeIII ionization fraction\n * @param xe    Input: sum total ionization fraction\n * @param nH    Input: comoving total number of hydrogen atoms\n * @param z     Input: current cosmological redshift\n * @param Hz    Input: current value of hubble parameter in 1/s\n * @param Tmat  Input: temperature of baryons in Kelvin\n * @param Trad  Input: temperature of photons in Kelvin\n * @param alpha Input: fine structure constant relative to today\n * @param me    Input: effective electron mass relative to today\n * @param dx_He_dz       Output: change in ionization fraction of helium HeIII\n * @return the error status\n */\nint hyrec_dx_He_dz(struct thermodynamics* pth, struct thermohyrec* phy, double x_H, double x_He, double xe, double nH, double z, double Hz, double Tmat, double Trad, double alpha, double me, double *dx_He_dz) {\n\n  /** Summary: */\n\n  /** - define local variables */\n  struct injection* pin = &(pth->in);\n  double xHeII = x_He*phy->data->cosmo->fHe;    // Different definitions between CLASS and HYREC-2\n\n  /** - do tests */\n  class_test(MODEL == FULL, phy->error_message, \"FULL mode is currently not allowed for HyRec-2\");\n\n  /** - assign variables */\n  if (pth->has_exotic_injection == _TRUE_) {\n    phy->data->cosmo->inj_params->ion = pin->pvecdeposition[pin->index_dep_ionHe]/nH/(_E_H_ion_*_eV_);\n    phy->data->cosmo->inj_params->exclya = pin->pvecdeposition[pin->index_dep_lya]/nH/(_E_H_lya_*_eV_);\n  }\n  else{\n    phy->data->cosmo->inj_params->ion = 0.;\n    phy->data->cosmo->inj_params->exclya = 0.;\n  }\n  if (pth->has_varconst == _TRUE_) {\n    phy->data->cosmo->fsR = alpha;\n    phy->data->cosmo->meR = me;\n  }\n\n  if (xHeII<phy->xHeII_limit) {\n    /** - don't evolve He below the limit */\n    *dx_He_dz=0;\n  }\n  else {\n\n    /** - convert to correct units, and retrieve derivative */\n    *dx_He_dz = -1./(1.+z)* rec_helium_dxHeIIdlna(phy->data, z, 1.-x_H, xHeII, Hz) / phy->data->cosmo->fHe;\n\n    /** - do error management */\n    if(phy->data->error != 0){\n      class_call_message(phy->error_message,\"rec_helium_dxHeIIdlna\",phy->data->error_message);\n      return _FAILURE_;\n    }\n  }\n\n  return _SUCCESS_;\n}\n"
    },
    "upstream_thermodynamics.c": {

      "utf8": "/** @file thermodynamics.c Documented thermodynamics module\n *\n * * Julien Lesgourgues, 6.09.2010\n * * Restructured by Nils Schoeneberg and Matteo Lucca, 27.02.2019\n * * Evolver implementation by Daniel Meinert, spring 2019\n *\n * Deals with the thermodynamical evolution.\n * This module has two purposes:\n *\n * - at the beginning, to initialize the thermodynamics, i.e. to\n *   integrate the thermodynamical equations, and store all\n *   thermodynamical quantities as a function of redshift inside an\n *   interpolation table.\n *\n * - to provide a routine which allow other modules to evaluate any\n *   thermodynamical quantities at a given redshift value (by\n *   interpolating within the interpolation table).\n *\n * The most important differential equations to compute the free\n * electron fraction x at each step are provided either by the HyRec\n * 2020 or RecFastCLASS code, located in the external/ directory. The\n * thermodynamics module integrates these equations using the generic\n * integrator (which can be set to ndf15, rkck4, etc.) The HyRec and\n * RecFastCLASS algorithms are used and called in the same way by this\n * module.\n *\n * In summary, the following functions can be called from other modules:\n *\n * -# thermodynamics_init at the beginning (but after background_init)\n * -# thermodynamics_at_z at any later time\n * -# thermodynamics_free at the end, when no more calls to thermodynamics_at_z are needed\n */\n\n#include \"thermodynamics.h\"\n\n#include \"history.h\"\n#include \"hyrectools.h\"\n#include \"helium.h\"\n#include \"wrap_hyrec.h\"\n\n\n/**\n * Thermodynamics quantities at given redshift z.\n * Evaluates all thermodynamics quantities at a given value of the redshift by reading the pre-computed table and interpolating.\n *\n * @param pba          Input: pointer to background structure\n * @param pth          Input: pointer to the thermodynamics structure (containing pre-computed table)\n * @param z            Input: redshift\n * @param inter_mode   Input: interpolation mode (normal or growing_closeby)\n * @param last_index   Input/Output: index of the previous/current point in the interpolation array (input only for closeby mode, output for both)\n * @param pvecback     Input: vector of background quantities (used only in case z>z_initial for getting ddkappa and dddkappa; in that case,\n should be already allocated (!) and filled (!), with format short_info or larger; in other cases, will be ignored)\n * @param pvecthermo Output: vector of thermodynamics quantities (assumed to be already allocated)\n * @return the error status\n */\n\nint thermodynamics_at_z(\n                        struct background * pba,\n                        struct thermodynamics * pth,\n                        double z,\n                        enum interpolation_method inter_mode,\n                        int * last_index,\n                        double * pvecback, //should be filled for z>z_initial!\n                        double * pvecthermo\n                        ) {\n\n  /** Summary: */\n\n  /** - define local variables */\n  double x0;\n  /* Dark matter baryon scattering */\n  double Vrms_idm_b2, T_diff_idm_b, m_b, FHe;\n  /* Varying fundamental constants */\n  double sigmaTrescale = 1., alpha = 1., me = 1.;\n\n  /* The fact that z is in the pre-computed range 0 <= z <= z_initial will be checked in the interpolation routines below. Before\n     trying to interpolate, allow the routine to deal with the case z > z_initial: then, all relevant quantities can be extrapolated\n     using simple analytic approximations */\n\n  if (z >= pth->z_table[pth->tt_size-1]) {\n\n    /* ionization fraction assumed to remain constant at large z */\n    x0= pth->thermodynamics_table[(pth->tt_size-1)*pth->th_size+pth->index_th_xe];\n    pvecthermo[pth->index_th_xe] = x0;\n\n    /* In the case of varying fundamental constants, compute correction factor (according to 1705.03925) */\n    if (pth->has_varconst == _TRUE_) {\n      class_call(background_varconst_of_z(pba, z, &alpha, &me),\n                 pba->error_message,\n                 pth->error_message);\n      sigmaTrescale = alpha*alpha/me/me;\n    }\n\n    /* Calculate dkappa/dtau (dkappa/dtau = a n_e x_e sigma_T = a^{-2} n_e(today) x_e sigma_T in units of 1/Mpc) */\n    pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dkappa] = (1.+z) * (1.+z) * pth->n_e * x0 * sigmaTrescale * _sigma_ * _Mpc_over_m_;\n\n    /* the baryon optical depth kappa_b scales like (1+z)**2 */\n    pvecthermo[pth->index_th_kappa_b] = pth->thermodynamics_table[(pth->tt_size-1)*pth->th_size+pth->index_th_kappa_b]*pow((1+z)/(1.+pth->z_table[pth->tt_size-1]),2);\n\n    if (pth->compute_damping_scale == _TRUE_) {\n\n      /* r_d scales like (1+z)**-3/2 */\n      pvecthermo[pth->index_th_r_d] = pth->thermodynamics_table[(pth->tt_size-1)*pth->th_size+pth->index_th_r_d]*pow((1+z)/(1.+pth->z_table[pth->tt_size-1]),-1.5);\n    }\n\n    /* Calculate d2kappa/dtau2 = dz/dtau d/dz[dkappa/dtau] given that [dkappa/dtau] proportional to (1+z)^2 and dz/dtau = -H */\n    pvecthermo[pth->index_th_ddkappa] = -pvecback[pba->index_bg_H] * 2. / (1.+z) * pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dkappa];\n\n    /* Calculate d3kappa/dtau3 given that [dkappa/dtau] proportional to (1+z)^2 */\n    pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dddkappa] = (pvecback[pba->index_bg_H]*pvecback[pba->index_bg_H]/ (1.+z) - pvecback[pba->index_bg_H_prime]) * 2. / (1.+z) * pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dkappa];\n\n    /* \\f$ exp^{-\\kappa}, g, g', g'' \\f$ can be set to zero: they are used only for computing the source functions in the\n       perturbation module; but source functions only need to be sampled below z_initial (the condition that\n       z_start_sources<z_initial is checked in the perturbation module) */\n    pvecthermo[pth->index_th_exp_m_kappa] = 0.;\n    pvecthermo[pth->index_th_g]=0.;\n    pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dg]=0.;\n    pvecthermo[pth->index_th_ddg]=0.;\n\n    /* Calculate Tb assuming Tb ~ T_g at early times */\n    pvecthermo[pth->index_th_Tb] = pba->T_cmb*(1.+z);\n\n    /* Tb derivative */\n    pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dTb] = pba->T_cmb;\n\n    /* Calculate baryon equation of state parameter wb = (k_B/mu) Tb */\n    /* note that m_H / mu = 1 + (m_H/m_He-1) Y_p + x_e (1-Y_p) */\n    pvecthermo[pth->index_th_wb] = _k_B_ / ( _c_ * _c_ * _m_H_ ) * (1. + (1./_not4_ - 1.) * pth->YHe + x0 * (1.-pth->YHe)) * pba->T_cmb * (1.+z);\n\n    /* Calculate cb2 (cb2 = (k_B/mu) Tb (1-1/3 dlnTb/dlna) = (k_B/mu) Tb (1+1/3 (1+z) dlnTb/dz)) */\n    /* note that m_H / mu = 1 + (m_H/m_He-1) Y_p + x_e (1-Y_p) */\n    pvecthermo[pth->index_th_cb2] = pvecthermo[pth->index_th_wb] * 4. / 3.;\n\n    /* derivatives of baryon sound speed (only computed if some non-minimal tight-coupling schemes is requested) */\n    if (pth->compute_cb2_derivatives == _TRUE_) {\n\n      /* since cb2 proportional to (1+z) or 1/a, its derivative wrt conformal time is given by dcb2 = - a H cb2 */\n      pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dcb2] = - pvecback[pba->index_bg_H] * pvecback[pba->index_bg_a] * pvecthermo[pth->index_th_cb2];\n\n      /* then its second derivative is given by ddcb2 = - a H' cb2 */\n      pvecthermo[pth->index_th_ddcb2] = - pvecback[pba->index_bg_H_prime] * pvecback[pba->index_bg_a] * pvecthermo[pth->index_th_cb2];\n    }\n\n    /* in this regime, variation rate = dkappa/dtau */\n    pvecthermo[pth->index_th_rate] = pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dkappa];\n\n    /* Quantities related to idm */\n    if (pba->has_idm == _TRUE_) {\n\n      /* Temperature and sound speed of idm (assuming T_idm ~ T_g at early times) */\n      pvecthermo[pth->index_th_T_idm] = pba->T_cmb* (1+z);\n      pvecthermo[pth->index_th_c2_idm] = _k_B_ * pba->T_cmb*(1+z)/(pth->m_idm*_eV_)  * (1 - (1.+z)/3./pvecback[pba->index_bg_H]);\n\n      /* For DM-g calculate at early times the optical depth parameters */\n      if (pth->has_idm_g == _TRUE_) {\n        /* calculate dmu_idm_g and its derivatives */\n        pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dmu_idm_g] = 3./8./_PI_/_G_*pow(1.+z, 2+pth->n_index_idm_g)*pba->Omega0_idm*pba->H0*pba->H0*pth->u_idm_g*pow(_c_,4)*_sigma_/1.e11/_eV_/_Mpc_over_m_;\n        pvecthermo[pth->index_th_ddmu_idm_g] = -(2.+pth->n_index_idm_g) * pvecback[pba->index_bg_H] * pvecback[pba->index_bg_a] * pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dmu_idm_g];\n        pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dddmu_idm_g] = (2.+pth->n_index_idm_g)*pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dmu_idm_g]/(1.+z) *\n          (pvecback[pba->index_bg_H]*pvecback[pba->index_bg_H]/(1.+z) * (1.+pth->n_index_idm_g) - pvecback[pba->index_bg_H_prime]);\n        /* extrapolate optical depth of idm_g */\n        if (pth->n_index_idm_g == -1){\n          pvecthermo[pth->index_th_exp_mu_idm_g] = pth->thermodynamics_table[(pth->tt_size-1)*pth->th_size+pth->index_th_exp_mu_idm_g] * exp( - pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dmu_idm_g] *pow(1.+z, -2-pth->n_index_idm_g) * log((1.+z)/(1.+pth->z_table[pth->tt_size-1]))*(1.+z)*(1.+z)/pvecback[pba->index_bg_H]);\n        }\n        else{\n          pvecthermo[pth->index_th_exp_mu_idm_g] = pth->thermodynamics_table[(pth->tt_size-1)*pth->th_size+pth->index_th_exp_mu_idm_g] * exp( - pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dmu_idm_g] *pow(1.+z, -2-pth->n_index_idm_g) /(1.+pth->n_index_idm_g) * (pow(1.+z,pth->n_index_idm_g+1)-pow(1.+pth->z_table[pth->tt_size-1],pth->n_index_idm_g+1))*(1.+z)*(1.+z)/pvecback[pba->index_bg_H] );\n        }\n      }\n\n      /* For idm_b calculate at early times the interaction rate parameters */\n      if (pth->has_idm_b == _TRUE_){\n\n        /* some constants used in the scattering rate and temperatures */\n        FHe = 1-pth->YHe;\n        m_b = _m_p_*_c_*_c_/_eV_;\n        Vrms_idm_b2 = 1.e-8; /* approximation for V_rms at early times */\n        T_diff_idm_b = (pvecthermo[pth->index_th_Tb]*_k_B_/_eV_/m_b)+(pvecthermo[pth->index_th_T_idm]*_k_B_/_eV_/pth->m_idm)+(Vrms_idm_b2/3.0); /* T and m are all in eV */\n\n        /* Now compute the coupling coefficients */\n        pvecthermo[pth->index_th_R_idm_b] = (pvecback[pba->index_bg_a]*pvecback[pba->index_bg_rho_b]*pth->cross_idm_b*pth->n_coeff_idm_b/(m_b+pth->m_idm))\n          *pow(T_diff_idm_b,(pth->n_index_idm_b+1.0)/2.0)*FHe\n          *(3.e-4*pow(_c_,4.)/(8.*_PI_*_Mpc_over_m_*_G_*_eV_)); /* conversion coefficient for the units */\n        pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dR_idm_b] = pvecthermo[pth->index_th_R_idm_b] * pvecback[pba->index_bg_a] * pvecback[pba->index_bg_H]\n          * ( -2. - (1.+z) * (pth->n_index_idm_b+1.0)/2.0 * (pba->T_cmb*_k_B_/_eV_/m_b + pba->T_cmb*_k_B_/_eV_/pth->m_idm)/T_diff_idm_b);\n      }\n\n      /* For idm_dr calculate at early times the optical depth parameters */\n      if (pth->has_idm_dr == _TRUE_){\n        /* calculate dmu_idm_dr and its derivatives */\n        pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dmu_idm_dr] = pth->a_idm_dr*pow((1.+z)/1.e7,pth->n_index_idm_dr)*pba->Omega0_idm*pow(pba->h,2);\n        pvecthermo[pth->index_th_ddmu_idm_dr] =  -pvecback[pba->index_bg_H] * pth->n_index_idm_dr / (1+z) * pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dmu_idm_dr];\n        pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dddmu_idm_dr] = (pvecback[pba->index_bg_H]*pvecback[pba->index_bg_H]/ (1.+z) * (pth->n_index_idm_dr - 1.) - pvecback[pba->index_bg_H_prime])\n          * pth->n_index_idm_dr / (1.+z) * pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dmu_idm_dr];\n\n        /* extrapolate optical depth of idm_dr and idr */\n        if (pth->n_index_idm_dr == 1 ){\n          pvecthermo[pth->index_th_tau_idr] = pth->thermodynamics_table[(pth->tt_size-1)*pth->th_size+pth->index_th_tau_idr]+pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dmu_idm_dr] * pow(1.+z, - pth->n_index_idm_dr) * log((1.+z)/(1.+pth->z_table[pth->tt_size-1]))/(pvecback[pba->index_bg_H]/(1.+z)/(1.+z));\n        }\n        else{\n          pvecthermo[pth->index_th_tau_idr] = pth->thermodynamics_table[(pth->tt_size-1)*pth->th_size+pth->index_th_tau_idr]+pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dmu_idm_dr] * pow(1.+z, - pth->n_index_idm_dr)/(1.-pth->n_index_idm_dr) * (pow(1.+pth->z_table[pth->tt_size-1], pth->n_index_idm_dr -1) - pow(1.+z, pth->n_index_idm_dr -1))/(pvecback[pba->index_bg_H]/(1.+z)/(1.+z));\n        }\n\n        if (pth->n_index_idm_dr == 0 ){\n          pvecthermo[pth->index_th_tau_idm_dr] = pth->thermodynamics_table[(pth->tt_size-1)*pth->th_size+pth->index_th_tau_idm_dr]+pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dmu_idm_dr] * pow(1.+z, - pth->n_index_idm_dr) * 4./3. * pba->Omega0_idr/pba->Omega0_idm * log((1.+z)/(1.+pth->z_table[pth->tt_size-1]))/(pvecback[pba->index_bg_H]/(1.+z)/(1.+z));\n        }\n        else{\n          pvecthermo[pth->index_th_tau_idm_dr] = pth->thermodynamics_table[(pth->tt_size-1)*pth->th_size+pth->index_th_tau_idm_dr]+pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dmu_idm_dr] * pow(1.+z, - pth->n_index_idm_dr) * 4./3. * pba->Omega0_idr/pba->Omega0_idm /(-pth->n_index_idm_dr) * (pow(1.+pth->z_table[pth->tt_size-1], pth->n_index_idm_dr) - pow(1.+z, pth->n_index_idm_dr))/(pvecback[pba->index_bg_H]/(1.+z)/(1.+z));\n        }\n\n        /* extrapolate idm_dr visibility function */\n        pvecthermo[pth->index_th_g_idm_dr] = pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dmu_idm_dr] * 4./3. * pba->Omega0_idr/pba->Omega0_idm * (1.+z) * exp(-pvecthermo[pth->index_th_tau_idm_dr]);\n      }\n\n    }\n\n    /* Quantities related to idr */\n    if (pba->has_idr == _TRUE_) {\n\n      /* Use the temperature scaling assumed throughout */\n      pvecthermo[pth->index_th_T_idr] = pba->T_idr* (1+z);\n\n      /* calculate dmu_idr (self interaction) */\n      pvecthermo[pth->index_th_dmu_idr] = pth->b_idr*pow((1.+z)/1.e7,pth->n_index_idm_dr)*pba->Omega0_idr*pow(pba->h,2);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** - interpolate in table with array_interpolate_spline (normal mode) or array_interpolate_spline_growing_closeby (closeby mode) */\n\n  else {\n\n    /* some very specific cases require linear interpolation because of a break in the derivative of the functions */\n    if (((pth->reio_parametrization == reio_half_tanh) && (z < 2*pth->z_reio))\n        || ((pth->reio_parametrization == reio_inter) && (z < 50.))) {\n\n      class_call(array_interpolate_linear(pth->z_table,\n                                          pth->tt_size,\n                                          pth->thermodynamics_table,\n                                          pth->th_size,\n                                          z,\n                                          last_index,\n                                          pvecthermo,\n                                          pth->th_size,\n                                          pth->error_message),\n                 pth->error_message,\n                 pth->error_message);\n    }\n\n    /* in the \"normal\" case, use spline interpolation */\n    else {\n\n      if (inter_mode == inter_normal) {\n\n        class_call(array_interpolate_spline(pth->z_table,\n                                            pth->tt_size,\n                                            pth->thermodynamics_table,\n                                            pth->d2thermodynamics_dz2_table,\n                                            pth->th_size,\n                                            z,\n                                            last_index,\n                                            pvecthermo,\n                                            pth->th_size,\n                                            pth->error_message),\n                   pth->error_message,\n                   pth->error_message);\n      }\n\n      if (inter_mode == inter_closeby) {\n\n        class_call(array_interpolate_spline_growing_closeby(pth->z_table,\n                                                            pth->tt_size,\n                                                            pth->thermodynamics_table,\n                                                            pth->d2thermodynamics_dz2_table,\n                                                            pth->th_size,\n                                                            z,\n                                                            last_index,\n                                                            pvecthermo,\n                                                            pth->th_size,\n                                                            pth->error_message),\n                   pth->error_message,\n                   pth->error_message);\n\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return _SUCCESS_;\n}\n\n/**\n * Initialize the thermodynamics structure, and in particular the\n * thermodynamics interpolation table.\n *\n * @param ppr   Input: pointer to precision structure\n * @param pba   Input: pointer to background structure\n * @param pth   Input/Output: pointer to initialized thermodynamics structure\n * @return the error status\n */\n\nint thermodynamics_init(\n                        struct precision * ppr,\n                        struct background * pba,\n                        struct thermodynamics * pth\n                        ) {\n\n  /** Summary: */\n\n  /** - define local variables */\n\n  /* vector of background values for calling background_at_tau */\n  double * pvecback;\n\n  /* structures for storing temporarily information on recombination and reionization */\n  struct thermo_workspace * ptw;\n\n  pth->has_idm_g = pba->has_idm && (pth->u_idm_g > 0.);\n  pth->has_idm_dr = pba->has_idm && (pba->has_idr && pth->a_idm_dr > 0.);\n  pth->has_idm_b = pba->has_idm && (pth->cross_idm_b > 0.);\n\n  /** - update the user about which recombination code is being run */\n  if (pth->thermodynamics_verbose > 0) {\n    switch (pth->recombination) {\n\n    case recfast:\n      printf(\"Computing thermodynamics using RecFastCLASS (based on v1.5)\\n\");\n      break;\n\n    case hyrec:\n      printf(\"Computing thermodynamics using HyRec 2020\\n\");\n      break;\n\n    default:\n      class_stop(pth->error_message,\"pth->recombination=%d different from all known cases\",pth->recombination);\n      break;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** - set flag for varying constants */\n  pth->has_varconst = pba->has_varconst;\n\n  /** - compute and check primordial Helium mass fraction rho_He/(rho_H+rho_He) */\n\n  if (pth->YHe == _YHE_BBN_) {\n    class_call(thermodynamics_helium_from_bbn(ppr,pba,pth),\n               pth->error_message,\n               pth->error_message);\n  }\n  if (pth->thermodynamics_verbose > 0) {\n    printf(\" -> with primordial helium mass fraction Y_He = %.4f\\n\",pth->YHe);\n  }\n\n  /** - infer primordial helium-to-hydrogen nucleon ratio n_He/n_H\n   * It is calculated via n_He/n_H = rho_He/(m_He/m_H * rho_H) = YHe * rho_b / (m_He/m_H * (1-YHe) rho_b) = YHe / (m_He/m_H * (1-YHe))*/\n  pth->fHe = pth->YHe/(_not4_ *(1.-pth->YHe));\n\n  /** - infer number of hydrogen nuclei today in m**-3 */\n  pth->n_e = 3.*pow(pba->H0 * _c_ / _Mpc_over_m_,2)*pba->Omega0_b/(8.*_PI_*_G_*_m_H_)*(1.-pth->YHe);\n\n  /** - test whether all parameters are in the correct regime */\n  class_call(thermodynamics_checks(ppr,pba,pth),\n             pth->error_message,\n             pth->error_message);\n\n  /** - allocate and assign all temporary structures and indices */\n  class_alloc(ptw, sizeof(struct thermo_workspace), pth->error_message);\n\n  /*  in the case of idm, we need to adapt the start of integration time,\n      to be sure we capture the time at which the two species are still coupled.\n      This is after thermo_workspace was allocated to set the has_ap_idmtca flag*/\n  class_call(thermodynamics_obtain_z_ini(ppr,pba,pth, ptw),\n             pth->error_message,\n             pth->error_message);\n\n  class_call(thermodynamics_workspace_init(ppr,pba,pth,ptw),\n             pth->error_message,\n             pth->error_message);\n\n  class_call(thermodynamics_indices(pba,pth,ptw),\n             pth->error_message,\n             pth->error_message);\n\n  class_alloc(pvecback,pba->bg_size*sizeof(double),pba->error_message);\n\n  class_call(thermodynamics_lists(ppr,pba,pth,ptw),\n             pth->error_message,\n             pth->error_message);\n\n  /** - initialize injection struct (not temporary) */\n  if (pth->has_exotic_injection == _TRUE_) {\n    class_call(injection_init(ppr,\n                              pba,\n                              pth),\n               (pth->in).error_message,\n               pth->error_message);\n  }\n\n  /** - assign reionisation parameters */\n  class_call(thermodynamics_set_parameters_reionization(ppr,\n                                                        pba,\n                                                        pth,\n                                                        ptw->ptrp),\n             pth->error_message,\n             pth->error_message);\n\n  /** - solve recombination and reionization and store values of \\f$ z, x_e, d \\kappa / d \\tau, T_b, c_b^2 \\f$  */\n  class_call(thermodynamics_solve(ppr,pba,pth,ptw,pvecback),\n             pth->error_message,\n             pth->error_message);\n\n  /** - the differential equation system is now completely solved  */\n\n  /** - fill missing columns (quantities not computed during the differential evolution but related) */\n  class_call(thermodynamics_calculate_remaining_quantities(ppr,pba,pth,pvecback),\n             pth->error_message,\n             pth->error_message);\n\n  /** - write information on thermal history in standard output */\n  if (pth->thermodynamics_verbose > 0) {\n    class_call(thermodynamics_output_summary(pba,pth),\n               pth->error_message,\n               pth->error_message);\n  }\n\n  /** - free workspace and local variables */\n  class_call(thermodynamics_workspace_free(pth,ptw),\n             pth->error_message,\n             pth->error_message);\n\n  free(pvecback);\n\n  pth->is_allocated = _TRUE_;\n\n  return _SUCCESS_;\n}\n\n\n/**\n * Free all memory space allocated by thermodynamics_init.\n *\n * @param pth Input/Output: pointer to thermodynamics structure (to be freed)\n * @return the error status\n */\nint thermodynamics_free(\n                        struct thermodynamics * pth\n                        ) {\n\n  if (pth->has_exotic_injection == _TRUE_) {\n    /* Free all injection-related functions */\n    class_call(injection_free(pth),\n               (pth->in).error_message,\n               pth->error_message);\n  }\n\n  /* Free thermodynamics-related functions */\n  free(pth->z_table);\n  free(pth->tau_table);\n  free(pth->thermodynamics_table);\n  free(pth->d2thermodynamics_dz2_table);\n\n  class_call(thermodynamics_free_input(pth),\n             pth->error_message,\n             pth->error_message);\n\n  pth->is_allocated = _FALSE_;\n\n  return _SUCCESS_;\n}\n/**\n * Free all memory space allocated by input.c for the thermodynamics module.\n *\n * @param pth Input/Output: pointer to thermodynamics structure (to be freed)\n * @return the error status\n */\nint thermodynamics_free_input(\n                        struct thermodynamics * pth\n                        ) {\n\n  switch(pth->reio_parametrization){\n\n  case reio_none:\n  case reio_camb:\n  case reio_half_tanh:\n  default:\n    /* nothing to be read*/\n    break;\n\n  case reio_bins_tanh:\n    /* Read */\n    free(pth->binned_reio_z);\n    free(pth->binned_reio_xe);\n    break;\n\n  case reio_many_tanh:\n    /* Read */\n    free(pth->many_tanh_z);\n    free(pth->many_tanh_xe);\n    break;\n\n    /** 8.d) reionization parameters if reio_parametrization=reio_many_tanh */\n  case reio_inter:\n    /* Read */\n    free(pth->reio_inter_z);\n    free(pth->reio_inter_xe);\n    break;\n\n  }\n\n  return _SUCCESS_;\n}\n/**\n * Infer the primordial helium mass fraction from standard BBN\n * calculations, as a function of the baryon density and expansion\n * rate during BBN.\n *\n * This module is simpler then the one used in arXiv:0712.2826 because\n * it neglects the impact of a possible significant chemical\n * potentials for electron neutrinos. The full code with xi_nu_e could\n * be introduced here later.\n *\n * @param ppr   Input: pointer to precision structure\n * @param pba   Input: pointer to background structure\n * @param pth   Input/Output: pointer to initialized thermodynamics structure\n * @return the error status\n */\nint thermodynamics_helium_from_bbn(\n                                   struct precision * ppr,\n                                   struct background * pba,\n                                   struct thermodynamics * pth\n                                   ) {\n\n  /** Summary: */\n\n  /** Define local variables */\n  FILE * fA;\n  char line[_LINE_LENGTH_MAX_];\n  char * left;\n\n  int num_omegab=0;\n  int num_deltaN=0;\n\n  double * omegab=NULL;\n  double * deltaN=NULL;\n  double * YHe=NULL;\n  double * ddYHe=NULL;\n  double * YHe_at_deltaN=NULL;\n  double * ddYHe_at_deltaN=NULL;\n\n  int array_line=0;\n  double DeltaNeff;\n  double omega_b;\n  int last_index;\n  double Neff_bbn, z_bbn, * pvecback;\n\n  /** - Infer effective number of neutrinos at the time of BBN */\n  class_alloc(pvecback,pba->bg_size*sizeof(double),pba->error_message);\n\n  /** - We randomly choose 0.1 MeV to be the temperature of BBN */\n  z_bbn = 0.1*1e6/(_eV_over_Kelvin_*pba->T_cmb)-1.0;\n\n  class_call(background_at_z(pba,\n                             z_bbn,\n                             long_info,\n                             inter_normal,\n                             &last_index,\n                             pvecback),\n             pba->error_message,\n             pth->error_message);\n\n  Neff_bbn = (pvecback[pba->index_bg_Omega_r]\n              *pvecback[pba->index_bg_rho_crit]\n              -pvecback[pba->index_bg_rho_g])\n    /(7./8.*pow(4./11.,4./3.)*pvecback[pba->index_bg_rho_g]);\n\n\n  //  printf(\"Neff early = %g, Neff at bbn: %g\\n\",pba->Neff,Neff_bbn);\n\n  /** - compute Delta N_eff as defined in bbn file, i.e. \\f$ \\Delta N_{eff}=0\\f$ means \\f$ N_{eff}=3.046\\f$.\n   * Note that even if 3.044 is a better default value, we must keep 3.046 here as long as the BBN file we are\n   * using has been computed assuming 3.046.\n   */\n  DeltaNeff = Neff_bbn - 3.046;\n\n  /* the following file is assumed to contain (apart from comments and blank lines):\n     - the two numbers (num_omegab, num_deltaN) = number of values of BBN free parameters\n     - three columns (omegab, deltaN, YHe) where omegab = Omega0_b h^2 and deltaN = Neff-3.046 by definition\n     - omegab and deltaN are assumed to be arranged as:\n     omegab1 deltaN1 YHe\n     omegab2 deltaN1 YHe\n     .....\n     omegab1 delatN2 YHe\n     omegab2 deltaN2 YHe\n     .....\n  */\n\n  FileName bbn_path;\n  class_sprintf(bbn_path,\"%s%s\",ppr->base_path,ppr->sBBN_file);\n  class_open(fA,bbn_path, \"r\",pth->error_message);\n\n  /* go through each line */\n  while (fgets(line,_LINE_LENGTH_MAX_-1,fA) != NULL) {\n\n    /* eliminate blank spaces at beginning of line */\n    left=line;\n    while (left[0]==' ') {\n      left++;\n    }\n\n    /* check that the line is neither blank neither a comment. In ASCII, left[0]>39 means that first non-blank character might\n       be the beginning of some data (it is not a newline, a #, a %, etc.) */\n    if (left[0] > 39) {\n\n      /* if the line contains data, we must interpret it. If (num_omegab, num_deltaN)=(0,0), the current line must contain\n         their values. Otherwise, it must contain (omegab, delatN, YHe). */\n      if ((num_omegab==0) && (num_deltaN==0)) {\n\n        /* read (num_omegab, num_deltaN), infer size of arrays and allocate them */\n        class_test(sscanf(line,\"%d %d\",&num_omegab,&num_deltaN) != 2,\n                   pth->error_message,\n                   \"could not read value of parameters (num_omegab,num_deltaN) in file %s\\n\",ppr->sBBN_file);\n\n        class_alloc(omegab,num_omegab*sizeof(double),pth->error_message);\n        class_alloc(deltaN,num_deltaN*sizeof(double),pth->error_message);\n        class_alloc(YHe,num_omegab*num_deltaN*sizeof(double),pth->error_message);\n        class_alloc(ddYHe,num_omegab*num_deltaN*sizeof(double),pth->error_message);\n        class_alloc(YHe_at_deltaN,num_omegab*sizeof(double),pth->error_message);\n        class_alloc(ddYHe_at_deltaN,num_omegab*sizeof(double),pth->error_message);\n        array_line=0;\n\n      }\n      else{\n\n        /* read (omegab, deltaN, YHe) */\n        class_test(sscanf(line,\"%lg %lg %lg\",&(omegab[array_line%num_omegab]),\n                          &(deltaN[array_line/num_omegab]),\n                          &(YHe[array_line])\n                          ) != 3,\n                   pth->error_message,\n                   \"could not read value of parameters (omegab,deltaN,YHe) in file %s\\n\",ppr->sBBN_file);\n        array_line ++;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  fclose(fA);\n\n  /** - spline in one dimension (along deltaN) */\n  class_call(array_spline_table_lines(deltaN,\n                                      num_deltaN,\n                                      YHe,\n                                      num_omegab,\n                                      ddYHe,\n                                      _SPLINE_NATURAL_,\n                                      pth->error_message),\n             pth->error_message,\n             pth->error_message);\n\n  omega_b=pba->Omega0_b*pba->h*pba->h;\n\n  class_test(omega_b < omegab[0],\n             pth->error_message,\n             \"You have asked for an unrealistic small value omega_b = %e. The corresponding value of the primordial helium fraction cannot be found in the interpolation table. If you really want this value, you should fix YHe to a given value rather than to BBN\",\n             omega_b);\n\n  class_test(omega_b > omegab[num_omegab-1],\n             pth->error_message,\n             \"You have asked for an unrealistic high value omega_b = %e. The corresponding value of the primordial helium fraction cannot be found in the interpolation table. If you really want this value, you should fix YHe to a given value rather than to BBN\",\n             omega_b);\n\n  class_test(DeltaNeff < deltaN[0],\n             pth->error_message,\n             \"You have asked for an unrealistic small value of Delta N_eff = %e. The corresponding value of the primordial helium fraction cannot be found in the interpolation table. If you really want this value, you should fix YHe to a given value rather than to BBN\",\n             DeltaNeff);\n\n  class_test(DeltaNeff > deltaN[num_deltaN-1],\n             pth->error_message,\n             \"You have asked for an unrealistic high value of Delta N_eff = %e. The corresponding value of the primordial helium fraction cannot be found in the interpolation table. If you really want this value, you should fix YHe to a given value rather than to BBN\",\n             DeltaNeff);\n\n  /** - interpolate in one dimension (along deltaN) */\n  class_call(array_interpolate_spline(deltaN,\n                                      num_deltaN,\n                                      YHe,\n                                      ddYHe,\n                                      num_omegab,\n                                      DeltaNeff,\n                                      &last_index,\n                                      YHe_at_deltaN,\n                                      num_omegab,\n                                      pth->error_message),\n             pth->error_message,\n             pth->error_message);\n\n  /** - spline in remaining dimension (along omegab) */\n  class_call(array_spline_table_lines(omegab,\n                                      num_omegab,\n                                      YHe_at_deltaN,\n                                      1,\n                                      ddYHe_at_deltaN,\n                                      _SPLINE_NATURAL_,\n                                      pth->error_message),\n             pth->error_message,\n             pth->error_message);\n\n  /** - interpolate in remaining dimension (along omegab) */\n  class_call(array_interpolate_spline(omegab,\n                                      num_omegab,\n                                      YHe_at_deltaN,\n                                      ddYHe_at_deltaN,\n                                      1,\n                                      omega_b,\n                                      &last_index,\n                                      &(pth->YHe),\n                                      1,\n                                      pth->error_message),\n             pth->error_message,\n             pth->error_message);\n\n  /** - Take into account impact of varying alpha on helium fraction */\n  if (pth->has_varconst == _TRUE_) {\n    pth->YHe *= pth->bbn_alpha_sensitivity * (pvecback[pba->index_bg_varc_alpha]-1.)+1.;\n  }\n\n  /** - deallocate arrays */\n  free(omegab);\n  free(deltaN);\n  free(YHe);\n  free(ddYHe);\n  free(YHe_at_deltaN);\n  free(ddYHe_at_deltaN);\n  free(pvecback);\n\n  return _SUCCESS_;\n}\n\n/**\n * Check the thermodynamics structure parameters for bounds and critical values.\n *\n * @param ppr   Input: pointer to precision structure\n * @param pba   Input: pointer to background structure\n * @param pth   Input: pointer to initialized thermodynamics structure\n * @return the error status\n */\n\nint thermodynamics_checks(\n                          struct precision * ppr,\n                          struct background* pba,\n                          struct thermodynamics * pth\n                          ) {\n\n  /** Summary: */\n\n  /** - check BBN Y_He fracion */\n  class_test((pth->YHe < _YHE_SMALL_)||(pth->YHe > _YHE_BIG_),\n             pth->error_message,\n             \"Y_He=%g out of bounds (%g<Y_He<%g)\",pth->YHe,_YHE_SMALL_,_YHE_BIG_);\n\n  /** - tests in order to prevent divisions by zero */\n  class_test(pth->YHe == 1.,\n             pth->error_message,\n             \"stop to avoid division by zero\");\n\n  /** - test initial condition for recombination */\n  class_test(ppr->thermo_z_initial < ppr->recfast_z_He_3,\n             pth->error_message,\n             \"increase z_initial in order to start before HeliumIII recombination\");\n\n  return _SUCCESS_;\n}\n\n/**\n * Initialize the thermodynamics workspace.\n *\n * The workspace contains the arrays used for solving differential\n * equations (dubbed thermo_diffeq_workspace), and storing all\n * approximations, reionization parameters, heating parameters.\n *\n * @param ppr        Input: pointer to precision structure\n * @param pba        Input: pointer to background structure\n * @param pth        Input: pointer to the thermodynamics structure\n * @param ptw        Input/Output: pointer to thermodynamics workspace\n * @return the error status\n */\n\nint thermodynamics_workspace_init(\n                                  struct precision * ppr,\n                                  struct background * pba,\n                                  struct thermodynamics * pth,\n                                  struct thermo_workspace * ptw\n                                  ) {\n\n  /** Summary: */\n\n  /** Define local variables */\n  int index_ap;\n  /* for varying fundamental constants */\n  double alpha = 1., me = 1.;\n\n  /** - number of z values */\n  ptw->Nz_reco_lin = ppr->thermo_Nz_lin;\n  ptw->Nz_reco_log = ppr->thermo_Nz_log;\n  ptw->Nz_reco = ptw->Nz_reco_lin + ptw->Nz_reco_log;\n  ptw->Nz_reio = ppr->reionization_z_start_max / ppr->reionization_sampling;\n  ptw->Nz_tot = ptw->Nz_reio + ptw->Nz_reco;\n\n  /** - relevant cosmological parameters */\n\n  /* primordial helium mass fraction */\n  ptw->YHe = pth->YHe;\n  /* primordial helium-to-hydrogen nucleon ratio */\n  ptw->fHe = pth->fHe;\n  /* Hubble parameter today in SI units */\n  ptw->SIunit_H0 = pba->H0 * _c_ / _Mpc_over_m_;\n  /* H number density today in SI units*/\n  ptw->SIunit_nH0 = 3.*ptw->SIunit_H0*ptw->SIunit_H0*pba->Omega0_b/(8.*_PI_*_G_*_m_H_)*(1.-ptw->YHe);\n  /* CMB temperature today in Kelvin */\n  ptw->Tcmb = pba->T_cmb;\n\n  /** - relevant constants */\n\n  /* Prefactor in non-relativistic number density for temperature -- (2*pi*m_e) and unit conversion */\n  ptw->const_NR_numberdens = 2.*_PI_*(_m_e_/_h_P_)*(_k_B_/_h_P_);\n  /* Ionization energy for HI -- temperature equivalent in Kelvin */\n  ptw->const_Tion_H = _h_P_*_c_*_L_H_ion_/_k_B_;\n  /* Ionization energy for HeI -- temperature equivalent in Kelvin */\n  ptw->const_Tion_HeI = _h_P_*_c_*_L_He1_ion_/_k_B_;\n  /* Ionization energy for HeII -- temperature equivalent in Kelvin */\n  ptw->const_Tion_HeII = _h_P_*_c_*_L_He2_ion_/_k_B_;\n\n  /* the field reionization_optical_depth is computed and filled later */\n\n  /** - Allocate and initialize differential equation workspace */\n  class_alloc(ptw->ptdw,\n              sizeof(struct thermo_diffeq_workspace),\n              pth->error_message);\n\n  // Initialize ionisation fraction.\n  ptw->ptdw->x_reio = 1.+2.*ptw->fHe;\n  ptw->ptdw->x_noreio = 1.+2.*ptw->fHe;\n\n  /** - define approximations */\n  index_ap=0;\n  /* Approximations have to appear in chronological order here! */\n  class_define_index(ptw->ptdw->index_ap_idmtca,ptw->has_ap_idmtca,index_ap,1); //DM tight coupling (assumed always before any recombination phases)\n  class_define_index(ptw->ptdw->index_ap_brec,_TRUE_,index_ap,1); // before H- and He-recombination\n  class_define_index(ptw->ptdw->index_ap_He1,_TRUE_,index_ap,1);  // during 1st He-recombination (HeIII)\n  class_define_index(ptw->ptdw->index_ap_He1f,_TRUE_,index_ap,1); // in between 1st and 2nd He recombination\n  class_define_index(ptw->ptdw->index_ap_He2,_TRUE_,index_ap,1);  // beginning of 2nd He-recombination (HeII)\n  class_define_index(ptw->ptdw->index_ap_H,_TRUE_,index_ap,1);    // beginning of H-recombination (HI)\n  class_define_index(ptw->ptdw->index_ap_frec,_TRUE_,index_ap,1); // during and after full H- and HeII-recombination\n  class_define_index(ptw->ptdw->index_ap_reio,_TRUE_,index_ap,1); // during reionization\n  ptw->ptdw->ap_size=index_ap;\n\n  /* Set correct initial approximation scheme */\n  ptw->ptdw->ap_current = ptw->ptdw->index_ap_brec;\n  if (ptw->has_ap_idmtca == _TRUE_)\n    ptw->ptdw->ap_current = ptw->ptdw->index_ap_idmtca;\n\n  /** - store all ending redshifts for each approximation */\n  class_alloc(ptw->ptdw->ap_z_limits,ptw->ptdw->ap_size*sizeof(double),pth->error_message);\n\n  if (ptw->has_ap_idmtca == _TRUE_)\n    ptw->ptdw->ap_z_limits[ptw->ptdw->index_ap_idmtca] = ptw->z_ap_idmtca;\n  ptw->ptdw->ap_z_limits[ptw->ptdw->index_ap_brec] =\n    ppr->recfast_z_He_1+ppr->recfast_delta_z_He_1; // beginning 1st He-recombination\n  ptw->ptdw->ap_z_limits[ptw->ptdw->index_ap_He1] =\n    ppr->recfast_z_He_2+ppr->recfast_delta_z_He_2; // end 1st He-recombination\n  ptw->ptdw->ap_z_limits[ptw->ptdw->index_ap_He1f] =\n    ppr->recfast_z_He_3+ppr->recfast_delta_z_He_3; // beginning 2nd He-recombination\n  ptw->ptdw->ap_z_limits[ptw->ptdw->index_ap_He2] =\n    ppr->recfast_z_early_H_recombination;          // beginning early H-recombination\n  ptw->ptdw->ap_z_limits[ptw->ptdw->index_ap_H] =\n    ppr->recfast_z_full_H_recombination;           // beginning full recombination equations\n  ptw->ptdw->ap_z_limits[ptw->ptdw->index_ap_frec] =\n    ppr->reionization_z_start_max;                 // beginning reionization\n  ptw->ptdw->ap_z_limits[ptw->ptdw->index_ap_reio] = 0.0; // today\n\n  /** - Rescale these redshifts in case of varying fundamental constants */\n  if (pth->has_varconst == _TRUE_) {\n    for (index_ap=0;index_ap<ptw->ptdw->ap_size;++index_ap){\n      class_call(background_varconst_of_z(pba,ptw->ptdw->ap_z_limits[index_ap], &alpha, &me),\n                 pba->error_message,\n                 pth->error_message);\n      ptw->ptdw->ap_z_limits[index_ap]*=me*alpha*alpha;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** - store smoothing deltas for transitions at the beginning of each aproximation */\n  class_alloc(ptw->ptdw->ap_z_limits_delta,ptw->ptdw->ap_size*sizeof(double),pth->error_message);\n\n  if (ptw->has_ap_idmtca == _TRUE_)\n    ptw->ptdw->ap_z_limits_delta[ptw->ptdw->index_ap_idmtca] = 0.;\n  ptw->ptdw->ap_z_limits_delta[ptw->ptdw->index_ap_brec] = 0.;\n  ptw->ptdw->ap_z_limits_delta[ptw->ptdw->index_ap_He1] = ppr->recfast_delta_z_He_1;\n  ptw->ptdw->ap_z_limits_delta[ptw->ptdw->index_ap_He1f] = ppr->recfast_delta_z_He_2;\n  ptw->ptdw->ap_z_limits_delta[ptw->ptdw->index_ap_He2] = ppr->recfast_delta_z_He_3;\n  ptw->ptdw->ap_z_limits_delta[ptw->ptdw->index_ap_H] = ppr->recfast_delta_z_early_H_recombination;\n  ptw->ptdw->ap_z_limits_delta[ptw->ptdw->index_ap_frec] = ppr->recfast_delta_z_full_H_recombination;\n  ptw->ptdw->ap_z_limits_delta[ptw->ptdw->index_ap_reio] = ppr->recfast_delta_z_reio;\n\n  /* With recombination computed by HyRec or Recfast, we need to allocate and initialize the wrappers */\n\n  switch (pth->recombination) {\n\n  case hyrec:\n    class_alloc(ptw->ptdw->phyrec,\n                sizeof(struct thermohyrec),\n                pth->error_message);\n\n    ptw->ptdw->phyrec->thermohyrec_verbose = pth->hyrec_verbose;\n    class_call(thermodynamics_hyrec_init(ppr,pba,pth,ptw->SIunit_nH0,pba->T_cmb,ptw->fHe, ptw->ptdw->ap_z_limits[ptw->ptdw->index_ap_brec],ptw->ptdw->phyrec),\n               ptw->ptdw->phyrec->error_message,\n               pth->error_message);\n    break;\n\n  case recfast:\n    class_alloc(ptw->ptdw->precfast,\n                sizeof(struct thermorecfast),\n                pth->error_message);\n\n    class_call(recfast_init(ppr,pba,pth,ptw->ptdw->precfast,pth->recfast_photoion_mode,ptw->fHe),\n               ptw->ptdw->precfast->error_message,\n               pth->error_message);\n\n    break;\n  }\n\n  /** - Allocate reionisation parameter workspace */\n  class_alloc(ptw->ptrp,\n              sizeof(struct thermo_reionization_parameters),\n              pth->error_message);\n\n  return _SUCCESS_;\n\n}\n\n/**\n * Assign value to each relevant index in vectors of thermodynamical\n * quantities, and the reionization parameters\n *\n * @param pba   Input: pointer to background structure\n * @param pth   Input/Output: pointer to thermodynamics structure\n * @param ptw   Input/Output: pointer to thermo workspace\n * @return the error status\n */\n\nint thermodynamics_indices(\n                           struct background * pba,\n                           struct thermodynamics * pth,\n                           struct thermo_workspace * ptw\n                           ) {\n\n  /** Summary: */\n\n  /** - define local variables */\n  struct thermo_reionization_parameters* ptrp = ptw->ptrp;\n  /* a running index for the vector of thermodynamics
